about: Approximate booster odds, not the official print run. Six commons, one of each ink; three uncommons; two rare-or-better slots rolled on a d10 (Legendary 1, Super Rare 4, Rare 5); one foil slot weighted out of 192. Weights are relative. A rarity with no cards left in the set drops out of the roll, and no card appears twice in one pack. With pauper on, only the rarities in pauperRarities are rolled, and a slot uses its pauper weights when it has them.
